description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {1}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning Reassembling Skeleton from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
